The '''Far Orbit Resort and Lodge''' was a place for [[hunter]]s to go. It was founded around [[40 BBY/Legends|40]] [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by an [[Unidentified Ithorian businessman|Ithorian]] and a [[Unidentified Rodian business partner|Rodian]]. Business boomed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but slowed down during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

The resort featured housing units, a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], and luxury outfittings as well as a storage warehouse. The resort employed several staff, including a [[Unidentified Far Orbit staff member|man]].

A group of lore-seekers arrived there to search for a rumored [[Unidentified Sith Lord's tomb (Athiss)|tomb]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Far Orbit Resort and Lodge serves as the location for the first act of ''[[Lost Knowledge]]'', the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beginner Game]]'' book.
